fields.Name: IT01 - Server RunView Cache Integrity
fields.Description: Server RunView cache integrity (S1-S31) against a live SQLServerDataProvider with an InstrumentedLocalStorageProvider. Deterministic checks always run; the mutation checks (S17/S23/S24/S29/S30) run only when the selector sets runMutationTests. Beyond field projection and hit/miss shape symmetry, dedup/linger, keyset and count_only non-poisoning, and no-cache entities, the bundle verifies OrderBy is part of the cache identity (S27), IgnoreMaxRows returns all rows on capped entities (S28), stored views honor their own WhereClause (S29), cached child rows refresh when a denormalized parent is renamed (S30), and read-permission is enforced on cache hits (S31).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Cache hit/miss/shape assertions hold with counters scoped to RunViewCache; ordering inside the bundle is load-bearing (S1->S2->S3 share the 's1' slot). ASC/DESC never cross-serve; IgnoreMaxRows returns all rows on capped entities; stored views return only their WhereClause rows; renamed-parent denormalized fields refresh; users without read permission are never served cached rows.
